title: RLH: Dynamics 365 on the go | enCloud9
meta: How enCloud9 moved RLH, a Los Angeles private equity firm, from on-premises CRM to cloud Dynamics 365 and customized the mobile app for meetings.
answer: RLH (Riordan, Lewis, and Haden) is a private equity firm headquartered in Los Angeles. It needed strong client communication and efficient information flow to a global client base. We migrated its on-premises CRM to cloud-based Dynamics 365 and customized the mobile app. End-user engagement rose, and staff now get instant access to vital data.
facts: Private equity (business services, healthcare, and government services)
outcomes: Staff have instant access to vital data for client interactions.
Management has better insight into employee activities.
Creating and accessing meeting notes and follow-up information is more efficient.
chapters: RLH (Riordan, Lewis, and Haden) is a private equity firm headquartered in Los Angeles, with a history of over four decades. It invests across business services, healthcare, and government services.
RLH needed to maintain strong client communication and efficient information flow to a global client base.
We migrated RLH's on-premises CRM system to cloud-based Dynamics 365.
We customized the Dynamics 365 mobile app to deliver key information on the go, supporting client interactions and meetings.

End-user engagement has risen significantly. Staff have instant access to vital data, management has better insight into employee activities, and meeting notes and follow-up information are faster to create and find.
author: Kristin Caniglia
